31056.title: A Short Film About Love
31056.overview: 19-year-old Tomek whiles away his lonely life by spying on his opposite neighbour Magda through binoculars. She's an artist in her mid-thirties, and appears to have everything - not least a constant stream of men at her beck and call. But when the two finally meet, they discover that they have a lot more in common than appeared at first sight...

70160.title: The Hunger Games
70160.overview: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.

458896.title: The Nightingale
458896.overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

624848.title: Why Slugs Have No Legs
624848.overview: Slugs have a hard time keeping up with the pace of life in the city of insects. When a financial crisis hits, the industrious bees only see one solution. Droll imagery and a jaunty soundtrack converge in this clever modern parable.
624848.trailerName: WHY SLUGS HAVE NO LEGS Trailer | TIFF 2019

840464.title: Greenland 2: Migration
840464.overview: Having found the safety of the Greenland bunker after the comet Clarke decimated the Earth, the Garrity family must now risk everything to embark on a perilous journey across the wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

898704.title: Desert Warrior
898704.overview: In 7th-century Arabia, Princess Hind becomes a warrior to defy the ruthless Emperor Kisra. Forged into a warrior and aided by legendary bandit Hanzala, Hind unites warring tribes for a last stand—the historic Battle of Dhi Qar—that will change history.

947600.title: Sidi Kaba and the Gateway Home
947600.overview: With the help of the goddess Mami Wata, Sidi Kaba, an 8‑year-old boy, tries to find his brother who has been taken prisoner by slave traders. A fantastic epic that delivers us along the road of slavery.
947600.original_title: Sidi Kaba et la porte du retour

1034256.title: Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders
1034256.overview: “Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders" peels back the layers of controversy surrounding the making of the 1980 thriller, "Cruising." Directed by William Friedkin, the film triggered fierce protests from the LGBTQ+ community for its portrayal of a serial killer targeting gay men in New York's leather bars. Friedkin drew inspiration from the brutal murder of Variety reporter Addison Verrill, blurring the boundaries between cinematic fiction and real-life tragedy.

1045968.title: The Fox
1045968.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

1103760.title: Awal Mula Hamka Vol. 3
1103760.overview: Depicts Hamka's childhood in Maninjau, West Sumatra, where he showed a great interest in tradition and literature, despite neglecting his education at the pesantren and often clashing with his father. After his mother divorced his father, Hamka went to Mecca to learn about organization, the hajj manasik system, and to pursue his life's greatest mission, building Islam in Indonesia. However, Hamka still struggled with his father and met Siti Raham, an extraordinary woman who became his greatest inspiration in life.

1107216.title: Pets on a Train
1107216.overview: When a train unexpectedly starts up, taking only pets with it, the animals discover that Hans, a badger with a grudge is behind it all. While the crash seems inevitable, the animals can count on Falcon, a roguish Raccoon who will do anything to save them.

1129104.title: Flavia
1129104.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

1143440.title: The Ice Tower
1143440.overview: Jeanne, a 15-year-old orphan, witnesses the shoot for a film adaptation of the fairy tale The Snow Queen, and she becomes fascinated by its star, Cristina, an actress who is just as mysterious and alluring as the Queen she is playing.

1250512.title: The Voices of Our Mother
1250512.overview: When a family matriarch falls seriously ill, relatives gather and discover their shared ancestral ties bind them in unexpected ways.

1254800.title: The Fence
1254800.overview: Horn is welcoming his partner Léone into the hut he shares with Cal, when a man called Alboury appears. He stays there until they return the body of his brother, who was killed on the site.
1254800.trailerName: The Fence / Le Cri des gardes (2026) - Trailer (French subs)

1270736.title: Дом ходуном
1270736.overview: A large construction company is trying to take over the territory of an orphanage in order to build an amusement park there. The director of the orphanage, with the support of his wards, is fighting for its preservation. The head of the construction company Borisov wants to achieve his goal by any means and hires a professional to solve controversial and slippery issues Polunin, as well as a careerist Chizhikov, who hires bandits. However, the bandits only aggravate the situation, creating more and more problems for Borisov. At the same time, Polunina, who tricked into getting a job as a physical education teacher in an orphanage, begins her subversive work.

1272720.title: Transit Times
1272720.overview: A year in the life of a family in a typical backyard in the center of the Moldovan capital Chisinau in the 1990s: Zina lives here with her husband Victor and daughter Eva and, like the other inhabitants of the house, struggles for the family's financial survival. Through the eyes of the family, we experience a country in transition after the fall of the Iron Curtain.

1273296.title: Conrad & Crab – Idiotic Gems
1273296.overview: Two less-than-splendid members of the judicial police of Perpignan arrive in the small town of Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines to watch over activities at the local gem market fair. In investigating a seemingly trivial matter, they stumble onto a potentially bigger criminal network.

1280784.title: Spades
1280784.overview: As a begrudged detective investigates a recent string of murders, he soon discovers his prime suspect is a mysterious vigilante out to bring down a ruthless up-and-coming crime syndicate.

1284496.title: Cycle of Time
1284496.overview: In 1950s France, Helene and Michel lead a simple life until a freak accident in 2025 leads to Helene becoming a bank executive and Michel struggling with unemployment and depression. Their children grow up in a technology-dominated world.

1290000.title: Wife & Dog
1290000.overview: The relentless greed of the Fairbank family and their associates fuels betrayal and murder in the battle for succession.

1290320.title: Labyrinth of Lost Boys
1290320.overview: A kid from the country gets lost in the big city looking for love, going on a series of increasingly bizarre dates while a serial killer is on the loose targeting boys his age.

1314832.title: Thingy
1314832.overview: A young woman will do anything to avoid her ex at a secluded house party. But a supernatural virus passing through the partygoers may take care of him for her.

1318864.title: A Man of His Time
1318864.overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

1324688.title: 7G Rainbow Colony 2
1324688.overview: Nearly 10 years post the tragic death of Anitha, Kathir's ailing mother makes desperate attempts to get him settled after sensing his attraction to the daughter of Flat No.7G's Newest Tenant.

flatrate.name: AP International South Cinema Amazon Channel

1356944.title: The Lonely Musketeer
1356944.overview: A unique closed-room thriller about greed, revenge and the tragedy of human trauma. Rupert wakes up in a locked room without any doors or windows. He has no clue how he got there, and all he has is his mobile phone. As he investigates, he is haunted by the past and slowly discovers the horror he has gotten into.

1364368.title: Purgatory: Zone of Murderers
1364368.overview: In the near future of South Korea, where it became lawless due to an economic crisis, a new authoritarian government implements the "Permanent Exile Law" to easily control the country. According to this law, death row inmates are permanently exiled to a detention center, the Purgatory, built in abandoned nuclear power plants. With a degree of self-governance granted by the government, the Purgatory gradually reaches a point where it is beyond external control, leaving the government struggling to find a solution. Yu-seong, a police officer who became a death row inmate due to the revenge for his daughter and wife, is offered a deal by the Director of NIS. Now Yu-seong must eliminate the Purgatory Boss, the king of the center, in exchange for possible pardon.

1369104.title: A Wave Standing Still
1369104.overview: Lost in thought in the midsummer heat, Georg suddenly has only one goal. To make his huge, overgrown garden beautiful again at the weekend. But as he spends his days alone in the house he once shared with his ex-wife Sieglinde, who comes to visit at the end of the weekend, he has to deal not only with the garden, but also with absurd visits, memories, nosy neighbours and himself.

1376400.title: Crawlers
1376400.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

1384528.title: OM Chapter 1: Udhiram - The Blood Wood

1396368.title: A Son
1396368.overview: Maria, an inexperienced school psychologist, senses that behind the apparent happiness of an eight-year-old boy, who has just arrived at the school, lies a secret, the consequences of which are unpredictable. If she is to find out, she will have to decipher what Guille’s mind translates into drawings, as well as overcoming his father’s intransigence.
1396368.trailerName: A SON. Official trailer. May 8 in theaters.

1400336.title: Focker-in-Law
1400336.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

1404304.title: The Isolate Thief
1404304.overview: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

1405200.title: Ben'Imana
1405200.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.
1405200.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 베니마나 Ben′imana | 월드 시네마

1408208.title: Exit 8
1408208.overview: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

1413200.title: Cotton Fever
1413200.overview: A mosaic of characters struggle with addiction and love on the streets of Boston during the height of the fentanyl epidemic

1414544.title: My Friend The Sun
1414544.overview: Diego, a father struggling to give his daughter Xóchitl a real home, sees his life transformed when the mural she paints opens a portal to Tollan, the realm of the Mexica gods. As Xóchitl is chosen as a possible Sixth Sun, the ambitious Tezcatlipoca plots to claim that power. Separated between worlds, father and daughter must face deception, gods, and their own flaws to reunite. With the help of unexpected allies, they discover that true strength is born from sacrifice, trust, and faith in humanity.

1418512.title: The Good Sister
1418512.overview: Springtime in Berlin occasions new beginnings, but has its darknesses too. When Sam is accused of rape, his sister Rose is asked to testify in the police investigation against him. Faced with uncomfortable questions and moral quandaries, Rose’s feelings toward her older brother are tested.

1421136.title: Two Times João Liberada
1421136.overview: João, an actress from Lisbon, as she stars in a biopic about Liberada, a gender-nonconforming figure persecuted by the Portuguese Inquisition in the 18th century. The film's production becomes a battleground as João clashes with the director over how Liberada’s legacy should be portrayed. These tensions deepen as João's dreams are increasingly haunted by Liberada's ghost, blurring the lines between past and present. When the director succumbs to a mysterious paralysis, leaving the film unfinished, João is left to navigate the unfolding chaos. She faces unanswerable questions, not only about the film's future but also about her own connection to Liberada’s spirit and story.

1427472.title: Into the Blue
1427472.overview: Philippe Croizon, a 26-year-old metal worker at Fonderies du Poitou, had no idea that his life would be turned upside down on March 5, 1994. On that day, the young father received three 20,000 V shocks while trying to dismantle the TV antenna hanging from the chimney of his house in Saint-Rémy-sur-Creuse. After two months in a coma, he woke up with all four limbs amputated. Thus began what he calls his "second life", which has enabled him to overcome his disability, meet his partner, Suzanna Sabino, and achieve some incredible sporting feats, including a swim across the English Channel in less than 24 hours.

1441488.title: 18 Holes to Paradise
1441488.overview: A family with a long history (and many members) gathers around a table in a mansion in southern Portugal. The region has transformed from a depressed area into a thriving tourist destination. Kisses, hugs, and greetings quickly turn into complaints and reproaches surrounding the big issue: What should be done with Daddy’s house? It is a tempting piece of cake, laden with rich family memories. But progress cannot be stopped.
1441488.trailerName: 18 BURACOS PARA O PARAÍSO - Trailer Oficial

1442960.title: Dark Thoughts
1442960.overview: A young family moves to the countryside to escape creditors. But in the village home of their deceased aunt, an evil more dangerous than any debt collector awaits them.

1451344.title: Husbands in Action
1451344.overview: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

1453776.title: Veronica's Secret
1453776.overview: A girl's disappearance spirals into unraveling a dark past and its secrets.

1470480.title: God Is Shy
1470480.overview: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet, her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.
1470480.trailerName: Trailer -  DIEU EST TIMIDE (God is shy) dir. Jocelyn Charles

1477712.title: Ice Cream Man
1477712.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

1484112.title: Brian
1484112.overview: An acerbic high school student prone to panic attacks runs for class president to get closer to his teacher.

1490000.title: The Stars That Fade
1490000.overview: After a tragic loss, a writer seeks comfort in publishing an anthology of horror stories. As his mental state deteriorates, his imagination blends with reality and tragedy seems imminent.

1491920.title: Kung Fu Soccer
1491920.overview: The "Supreme Invincible Cup" is about to begin, and a host of top teams are about to engage in an unprecedented showdown! But the Kung Fu Women's Soccer Team has been dealt a hellish script right from the start?! Their opponents are all highly skilled, and external pressure is mounting. The schemes on the field are one after another... Can they use their kung fu to turn the tide on the green field?
1491920.trailerName: Kung Fu Soccer《功夫女足》- Official Trailer

1504848.title: Leader
1504848.overview: An ordinary man becomes trapped between warring criminal factions and law enforcement, forcing him to use his wits to survive while shielding his loved ones from the deadly crossfire that threatens to consume them all.

1509968.title: We, Brothers
1509968.overview: Two old fellow mobsters meet up at hideout to discuss their next job. They plunge into a conversation recollecting their past deeds together, which leads them into argument and rivalry, until one of them realizes something is quite wrong.

1520592.title: River
1520592.overview: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

1525072.title: The Perfect Holiday
1525072.overview: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

1536720.title: Mag Mag
1536720.overview: The revenge story of a woman whose partner is murdered by a ghost, and who will soon discover the true identity of the one she must avenge.
1536720.trailerName: Mag Mag 禍禍女 (directed by Yuriyan Retriever) trailer

1541200.title: The Frog Princess 3
1541200.overview: Continuation of the franchise "The Frog Princess".

1542352.title: Youth
1542352.overview: Youth follows Praveen, a 15-year-old boy who enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. As he goes through multiple relationships and heartbreaks, he slowly begins to understand what love truly means. Along the way, the experiences shape his growth, maturity, and outlook on life.

1544848.title: Rough
1544848.overview: Struggling to finish a screenplay that's all but consumed him, an ambitious writer turns to his ex for inspiration, only to realize that the ending he's looking for may lie in the unresolved chapters of their own story.

1545360.title: The General
1545360.overview: In 1944, after years of longing, the Golian family finally welcomes a child-just weeks before the beginning of Slovak National Uprising led by Ján Golian. In Nazi-allied Slovakia, they must choose-fight for the nation or protect their son.

1560208.title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
1560208.overview: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.
1560208.trailerName: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka Trailer | Allari Naresh | Surbhi | Chandra Mohan | Annapurna Studios

1561360.title: Swamped
1561360.overview: A 19 year old college student named Rowan lives through a day in her life, which means constant agony in her own brain. Rowan is trapped in a battle with herself, dealing with her obsessions and compulsions, as well as trying to adjust to a new social life.

1562000.title: An Encounter
1562000.overview: Desiring intimacy one Friday night, Eli rollerblades away from his friends to have sex for the first time with an older man he met online.

1569872.title: Dream High
1569872.overview: A cinematic rock opera and an homage to teen films, adapted from the stage musical with the same name by Amit Ulman, scripted completely in Hebrew rhymes. Yoav, a teenage boy who lives with his single mother, who struggles to finance them, moves to a new city. He joins Magshimim High, where words hit harder than punches, and your rhyming skills determine the food chain. After the "class king" demolishes him in a rap battle, Yoav is determined to prove himself and win the heart of the "class queen", Maya. He encounters Hamorabi, a legendary former rapper who hides under the image of the school's kiosk cashier. With his help, Yoav turns from an outcast to the Star of the Battles. But as he climbs high, he draws apart from the friends who stood by his side, the girl who really saw him when no one else had, and the authenticity taught to him by Hamorabi. In the National Rap Championship, Yoav will have to choose between chasing the shining lights of fame or staying true to himself.
1569872.trailerName: תיכון מגשימים - הטריילר | מחווה בראפ לסרטי תיכון | 23.7 בקולנוע

1571792.title: The Cauliflower of Destiny
1571792.overview: Stifled Ania, trapped in a grimy grocery store, is suffocating under her mother’s toxic control. Salvation arrives via a discarded cauliflower that, unsettlingly, starts talking. At first a witty mentor, the vegetable’s advice soon sours into a grotesque push for revenge. As her rebellion escalates from petty pranks to radical acts, Ania must decide: is this edible oracle her savior or a deranged voice of self destruction? A darkly comic journey where freedom tastes like rot.

1577040.title: Sawtooth Mountain
1577040.overview: Three college students get entangled in a horrifying ordeal after booking a Bigfoot-themed cabin run by two paranormal-obsessed brothers.

1578960.title: Alma
1578960.overview: A young woman, in the midst of caring for her dying father, must shoulder the weight of her world over the course of a day.

1580496.title: House of Death
1580496.overview: At night, a boy is terrorized by a dark latex figure.

1584720.title: Recep Ivedik 8
1584720.overview: 8th installment of Recep İvedik. Plot TBA.

1587472.title: Doll
1587472.overview: The dramatic story of Nadya, a young woman who, after a misstep in her youth (killing her unfaithful fiancé), tries to right her wrongs and return to a normal life. After serving her sentence, Nadya begins searching for the daughter she gave birth to in prison, and her friend Andrei helps her. Nadya's subconscious and the immense power of maternal love create a unique world in her imagination, through which she now lives.

1588240.title: Новый дом
1588240.overview: After seven years in prison, Anna is released. She has no home, no family, no purpose in life, and the guilt over her past haunts her. A charity helps her find a job, provides a place in a dormitory, and refers her to a psychological support group. There, Anna meets Roman, who helps her realize that to move on with her life fully, she needs to address what's weighing her down. She decides to take a step that could change everything.

1593168.title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
1593168.overview: Home alone on the eve of her First Communion, 12-year-old Carmen receives an unexpected visit from a trio of neighborhood roller girls and scooter boys. While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

1599056.title: Artificial Love
1599056.overview: A lonely man falls in love with his ChatGPT companion, challenging the boundaries of love and what it means to be human.

1599184.title: 斗破苍穹剧场版 双帝之战

1609104.title: Love in the Countryside
1609104.overview: Ana, a city girl, raised in comfort, has managed to upset her father. In order to learn some humility and appreciate life in its simplicity, Ana is "exiled" to the countryside, to live with her grandmother for a while. For Ana, life in the village is a nightmare: heels sink into the mud, internet not so much, and people are strange.

1611600.title: English
1611600.overview: After a solar flare causes society's collapse, a new world emerges under the control of the N.E.S.T organisation, where the illusion of freedom masks a sinister reality.

1612048.title: S/H/V
1612048.overview: Four students, who make money by putting stolen school items online, are hired to steal a VHS tape from their Physical Education Teacher’s Office. However, things take a turn for the worse, when they find dozens of tapes, and being kids, they dare each other to partake in watching them.

1616400.title: #SKYKING
1616400.overview: Tells the story of 28-year-old Horizon Air ground service agent Richard “Beebo” Russell, who, to the shock of all who knew him, clocked into work wearing a shirt that said “sky’s no limit,” stole a 33-million-dollar plane, and took off into the skies of the Pacific Northwest embarking on a white-knuckle flight that would come to embody the hopes, dreams, and despair of the American working class, and offer a timely look into the U.S. mental health crisis.

1616592.title: Memories of Flesh and Bone
1616592.overview: In the capital of southern Brazil in the 1890s, a beautiful and mysterious couple gained notoriety, both for the achievements of the husband, Dr. Gustavo Ramos, and for the morbid personality of his wife, Katalina Paulsen.  When fear strikes, terrible secrets are revealed.

1623376.title: Blue Lock
1623376.overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

1623568.title: Agito: Superpower War
1623568.overview: In a world where people awaken to supernatural powers, one ordinary police officer Makoto Hikawa stands against this chaos.
1623568.trailerName: 「仮面ライダーアギト」25年ぶり完全新作！要潤が仮面ライダーG7に変身！賀集利樹らキャスト再集結　『アギトー超能力戦争ー』本予告

1624080.title: The Woman Before Me
1624080.overview: When Jenna learns her husband was once married to a woman who could be her double, she unravels a chilling pattern of obsession, deceit, and murder that makes her question whether she’s his next victim.

1626640.title: Birthmark
1626640.overview: After a client wiht an unusual birhtmark knocks on the doors of the apartment of a transgender artist, the latter tries to piece together where the two of them have previously met.

1627792.title: Sagaran
1627792.overview: As female motorcycle racer Mica and her mechanic boyfriend Migo join a motor shop's team, they try to navigate a new set of complicated relationships that'll push them to the limit.

1628752.title: Rabbit on a Highway
1628752.overview: A neurotic, alcoholic trans man struggles through navigating his social and love life.
1628752.trailerName: RABBIT ON A HIGHWAY | OFFICIAL TRAILER

1631504.title: Patlabor EZY: File 1
1631504.overview: Patlabor EZY File 1 is the first of a 3-part theatrical series taking place in 2036, 38 years after the events of Patlabor on Television and The New Files.

1645200.title: Disco Hall Commitments
1645200.overview: "(...)the most important event of my day has been remembering the improbable adventure of H.K: 5000 years after the first kalaallit expedition, renowned and reviled archaeologist Herbjørg Kristofferson tries to lift up an ambitious budget for a reckless expedition to the Secret Pavilion of Monk Ko-Hu, near the Russian Arctic"

1649424.title: 70 Up
1649424.overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

1650896.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
1650896.overview: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

1653840.title: Rescued by Faith: The Connie and Larry Van Oosten Story
1653840.overview: Connie and Larry Van Oosten are jolted awake by a masked gunman standing at the foot of their bed. Abducted from their home and locked inside a hidden bunker, the couple must endure days of torment.

1658384.title: Aimée & Samir
1658384.overview: Aimée de Jongh, a renowned comic-book illustrator, travels to Lesbos to conduct research for her new book about Samir, a fictional Syrian boy.

1659152.title: Comparable
1659152.overview: A Writer struggles to tap into his imagination as another, younger Writer shows off in front of him.

1663312.title: All My Friends Are Back In Brisbane
1663312.overview: A young woman is dumped by her fiance in London, returns home, and has to work with her married ex.

1663504.title: Chaser Game W: A Match Made in Heaven
1663504.overview: Seven years after the events of “Chaser Game W2: The Beautiful Celestial Maidens”—Itsuki and Fuyu now live in Ito City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with their daughter Tsuki, who is in middle school. Amid their busy daily lives filled with housework, parenting, and work, the time they spend together has gradually become something they take for granted. Over the course of those seven years, their relationship has shifted from “lovers” to “family,” and subtle emotional distance has begun to emerge between them. Though their hearts are shaken by each other’s casual words and actions, they continue to maintain the appearance of a peaceful household. However, their daughter Tsuki senses the growing unease between her parents. One day, after getting caught up in trouble, Tsuki is helped by a taxi driver named Kozue. This encounter becomes a turning point, prompting Itsuki and Fuyu to finally confront their true feelings and reexamine the form their love has taken as it drifted apart.

1665744.title: Sarpanch
1665744.overview: For the last two decades, in the rural heartlands of Punjab, the elected leadership of a small village has done nothing to develop the community, instead engaging in corrupt and harmful practices. To save his home and combat pressing issues, Fateh steps up to take charge and run for the position of Sarpanch (village head), which forces him to confront intense opposition.
1665744.trailerName: Sarpanch | Official Trailer | Dev Kharoud | Jasmin Bajwa | Sarbjit | Gurbaz | Dakssh | Rel 10th July

1665808.title: Tarototu

1689680.title: Voice Messages From My Mom

While we hear the mother’s voice, we see the daughter moving through her routines in Maastricht. As the voice messages accumulate, they reveal the emotional complexities between a mother and daughter living in different worlds. The contrast between the voice and the visuals reveal the unspoken tension between them: love expressed through control, sacrifice that becomes expectation, and the loneliness that can grow between two people who are always in contact but no longer fully connected. The film explores what it means to be loved by someone who doesn’t entirely understand you, and the emotional burden that can come with that love.

Director May Matchim draws connections between these incredible species and her own journey accepting her Transness. The title is a reference to the green frog, an amphibian which is able to change its sex as it matures.  This film includes a variety of animal and plant subjects, including same-sex bird parents raising chicks together, and a group of salamanders that's entirely female. It also examines the exclusionary attitudes in biology and conservation throughout time, and how these attitudes have influenced our understanding of animal behaviour.
